name: TDARFAC Applied Conservation Grants

funder.name: Dr. Abigail Ross Foundation for Applied Conservation (TDARFAC)

summary: Annual grants of up to US$5,000 (six months or less) or US$10,000 (longer) for applied and community-based conservation projects linked to primate conservation, awarded to a named project lead living in a primate range country.

amount.note: Up to US$5,000 for projects of six months or less, up to US$10,000 for longer ones

reporting: A final report within six months of project completion, either 800-1,300 words or a 2-4 minute video.

status.quote: The 2027 Applied Conservation Grant call for proposals will open on December 10, 2026, and close on January 8, 2027.

deadline.quote: Application Deadline: 23:59 Central Standard Time (CST) on January 8, 2027

applicant_types.quote: Funding will be awarded to a named individual Principal Investigator or project lead rather than directly to an institution.

window.quote: The 2027 Applied Conservation Grant call for proposals will open on December 10, 2026, and close on January 8, 2027.

amount.quote: Short-Term or Pilot Projects Project duration: Six (6) months or shorter Maximum award: $5,000 USD Long-Term Projects Project duration: Longer than six (6) months Maximum award: $10,000 USD

reporting.quote: Grant recipients must submit a final report in English within six (6) months of project completion. Final reports may be either: A written report of 800-1,300 words, or A 2-4-minute visual/video report Video reports are encouraged and preferred.

geography.quote: Our Annual Grants Program is open to conservationists residing in primate range countries
